data.title: Unitree’s Shanghai IPO 5,526 Times Subscribed by Retail Buyers
data.description: The highly anticipated initial public offering of Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, drew huge demand from retail investors as China’s leading humanoid robot maker opened books in Shanghai.
